import MeasureTheory.Measure.Gaussian
import MeasureTheory.Measure.NullMeasurableSet
import MeasureTheory.Integrals
import Analysis.InnerProductSpace

open MeasureTheory

theorem lg_target {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian μ] [CompleteSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] (h : ∀ (x : E), μ ≠ MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x) : MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass μ := by
  intro x
  have h_not_dirac : ¬∃ (y : E), μ = MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac y := by
    intro H
    cases H with y
    exact h y
  contrapose h_not_dirac
  intro H
  cases H with y
  exact h y
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure μ := by apply_instance
  haveI : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ := by apply_instance
  haveI : IsContinuousFunction (MeasureTheory.charFun μ) := by apply_instance
  haveI : Continuous (MeasureTheory.charFun μ) := by apply_instance
  have h_char_fun_continuous_at_x : ContinuousAt (MeasureTheory.charFun μ) x := by apply_instance
  have h_char_fun_limit_zero : tendsto (MeasureTheory.charFun μ) x (pure 0) := by
    rw [tendsto_const]
    exact ContinuousAt.tendsto h_char_fun_continuous_at_x
  have h_char_fun_eq_zero : (MeasureTheory.charFun μ) x = 0 := by
    rw [h_char_fun_limit_zero]
  have h_char_fun_integral_zero : ∫ x, (MeasureTheory.charFun μ) x ∂μ = 0 := by
    rw [h_char_fun_eq_zero]
    exact measure_theory.integral_const
  haveI : IsNullMeasurableSet {x} μ := by
    contrapose h_not_dirac
    intro H
    cases H with y
    exact h y
  exact MeasureTheory.NullMeasurableSet.measure_zero this
  exact NullSingletonClass.mk (λ x, 0)
